projectTemplates.title: Project templates
projectTemplates.intro: A template gives a new project its stages, its to-dos with leads, and its dates.
projectTemplates.empty: No project templates are saved yet.
projectTemplates.name: Template name
projectTemplates.rolesHint: A to-do lead leads the to-dos of this kind. Each new project confirms the person.
projectTemplates.stagesHint: Days are working days, Sunday to Thursday. Day 0 is the project start.
projectTemplates.stageDaysHint: The stage covers its own days and its to-dos.
projectTemplates.noOtherTemplate: No other template is saved yet.
projectTemplates.timelineEmpty: Add a to-do with a start day and working days to see the timeline.
projectTemplates.timelineHint: Drag a bar to move it. Drag its end to change its length. Drag a dot from one bar to another, and the second bar waits for the first.
projectTemplates.loopLink: This link would make a loop.
projectTemplates.linkLimit: A part can have at most {{n}} waits.

errors.name: Give the template a name.
errors.roleTwice: Two roles have the same name.
errors.stageTwice: Two stages have the same name.

link.title: Link {{project}} to {{template}}
link.intro: Madar matched the template parts to the project by name. Change a pick if it is wrong.
link.linked: The project is linked to the template.
link.summary: {{stages}} of {{stageTotal}} stages and {{tasks}} of {{taskTotal}} to-dos match.
link.restLabel: What to do with the parts with no match
link.leaveOut: Leave them out. The project keeps its own plan.
link.addThem: Add them to the project, with the dates of the template.

update.intro: Each linked project can take the changes of this template. Pick the projects to update.

kind.bringBack: Template items this project leaves out
kind.removed: Items the template no longer has

update.peopleLine: People who lead or help the changed to-dos: {{people}}.
update.stoppedTitle: The update stopped. The projects before it stay changed.
update.limit: You can update 50 projects at one time. Update the rest in a second round.
update.matches: These projects already match the template.
update.matchesOne: This project already matches the template.

tick.removed: Delete the ones not started yet
tick.edited: Use the template, not the version of the team

update.editedHint: The team changed these too. They stay as they are unless you tick the box.

projectTemplates.pickPart: Pick a stage or a to-do to see its details.
projectTemplates.stageStartNote: The to-dos move with the stage.
projectTemplates.nowStartsMore: {{name}} now starts on day {{day}}. The parts that wait for it moved too.
projectTemplates.discardTitle: Discard the changes to this template?

problem.stageDays: {{name}}: add the working days, or clear the start day.
problem.stageStart: {{name}}: add the start day, or clear the working days.
problem.numbers: {{name}}: use a start day from 0 to 2000 and working days from 1 to 365.

projectTemplates.deletedKept_one: Template deleted. 1 project keeps its to-dos.
projectTemplates.deletedKept_other: Template deleted. {{count}} projects keep their to-dos.
projectTemplates.keepTheirDays: Keep their days from the other template
projectTemplates.deletedKept: Template deleted. {{count}} projects keep their to-dos.

apply.title: Apply a template
apply.intro: Choose a template for {{project}}. Madar matches its stages and to-dos to the project by name.
apply.another: I want to apply another template. The project follows the new one instead.
apply.noTemplates: No project templates are saved yet.
apply.leads: Each new to-do gets the default person of its role as lead. A role with no active person leaves the to-do with no lead.
apply.dates: The new parts run from {{from}} to {{to}}.
apply.datesMoved: The dates of the template are past, so the new parts move forward.
apply.noStart: The project has no start date, so the new parts get no dates.

templateUse.endHint: Empty keeps the length of the template.
templateUse.lengthEnds: Template length: {{template}} working days. The project ends on {{date}}.
templateUse.lengthNew: Template length: {{template}} working days. This project: {{project}} working days.
templateUse.tooShort: The locked to-dos need at least {{needs}} working days. Choose a later end date, or let more to-dos stretch.
templateUse.stretchHint: Ticked to-dos stretch or shrink to the end date. Untick a to-do to keep its length.

errors.startRequired: A template needs a start date.

reasons.template_too_short: The locked to-dos need at least {{names}} working days. Choose a later end date, or let more to-dos stretch.
reasons.already_linked: This project is already linked to a template.
reasons.part_not_in_template: A part of the link is not in the template. Reload the page and try again.
reasons.item_not_in_project: An item is not in this project. Reload the page and try again.
reasons.duplicate_match: One project item matches two parts of the template. Choose each item once.
reasons.not_linked: This project is not linked to a template. Link it first.
reasons.other_template: This project is linked to another template.
reasons.project_closed: This project is closed. Choose an open project.

project.template_synced: updated this project from the template {{template}}
project.template_synced_plain: updated this project from its template
